pages.title: Weather and Danger
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Storms**: lightning can strike a ship, and extreme wind pushes ships hard.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Pillager airships** hunt you in tiers, from Scout to Flagship. Ships can be captured.
- **Sky whales** over oceans give Whale Bone Dust, a way to Levitite Blend without the End.
The sky is not empty. Storms and lightning push ships, pillager airships hunt them, and whales drift above the oceans. All of it comes from add-ons that need Aeronautics.

pages.title: Weather
pages.text: Winds & Weather adds weather regions with storms and lightning that can strike a ship. Wind is stronger over open ocean and grows with altitude, and **extreme wind pushes ships hard**. Rain itself follows the normal weather: when you see rain, it counts as rain for drinking, crops and cauldrons. Check your wind with an [#](2E5AAC)[Anemometer](entry://flight/wind_sailing)[#]().

pages.title: Hostile Skies
pages.text:
Create Hostile Skies sends pillager airships after you, in tiers: **Scout, Patrol, Warship, Flagship**.

- Your captain kills open higher tiers (accidents don't count).
- Rarer here: a try every 25 minutes, from 5%% chance.
- Bad Omen raises crew and loot. Ships can be captured.

pages.title: Captain's Orders
pages.text: One of two Hostile Skies items, with the Peace Treaty. They have no crafting recipe in the pack; read the tooltip.

pages.title: Sky Whales
pages.text: Rare sky whales drift high over oceans. A dead one leaves a slowly sinking corpse of whale bone and meat blocks that behave as [#](7A3C9A)[physics objects](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#](). Crushing bone gives Whale Bone Dust, which becomes End Stone Powder or, mixed, [#](2E5AAC)[Levitite Blend](entry://flight/balloons_and_lift)[#]().

pages.title: Whale Bone Dust
pages.text: Crush or mill whale bone. [#](2E5AAC)[Heated mixing](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() with zinc nuggets and water makes Levitite Blend, bypassing the End.

pages.title: Cooked Whale Meat
pages.text: Raw whale meat can be cooked into food.
